graydient_workflow.author: UnlimitedEditing / Graydient Pipeline
graydient_workflow.description:
Media Metadata Report - describes the file Graydient attached to the job.

Attach (or reply with) a video, an image or an audio file and this workflow
returns ONE image: a metadata card for that file.

VIDEO cards carry: container format, duration, bit rate, stream count,
creation time, codec + profile + level, resolution (and coded resolution),
display/sample aspect ratio, average and real frame rate, TOTAL FRAMES,
pixel format, bit depth, colour space/primaries/transfer, chroma location,
field order, rotation, time base, per-stream tags, the audio stream's
codec/sample rate/channels/bit rate, file size and modification time.

IMAGE cards carry: format, resolution, colour mode, frame count, animation,
DPI and the EXIF block (DateTimeOriginal, make, model, software, GPS...).
AUDIO cards carry: codec, sample rate, channels, channel layout, duration,
bit rate and sample format.

SETTINGS:
  - prompt_positive: optional caption printed on the card's header line
  - width / height: card size in pixels (the card grows taller if the
    report needs it; text is never shrunk below legibility)

No model, no GPU, no quota burn: it only reads the attached file.
